details: Actelion reported Opsumit per product from launch, but only in part: 2013Q4 CHF 5m, 2014Q3 CHF 59m and 2014Q4 CHF 68m, 2015Q3 CHF 147m, 2016Q1 CHF 178m and 2016Q3 CHF 218m are stated outright, while 2015Q1, 2015Q2, 2015Q4 and 2016Q4 are not separately citable and 2015H1 (CHF 207m) is one equation in two unknowns. From 2017Q3 the product sits in J&J's key-products schedule and from 2025 in a combined OPSUMIT/OPSYNVI line. No contiguous launch-to-end series exists, so FY2013 and FY2014 are carried as annual context instead of a quarterly benchmark.
source_quote: J&J reports OPSUMIT / OPSYNVI as a combined worldwide line beginning in 2025.
